title: Unit 408 hallway: three directions (A, B, C)
overview: Three hallway directions for Unit 408 around one fixed idea: the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203 hung at true scale (104 x 65 cm, bottom edge at 1.1 m) on the plain wall over a solid floor-standing cabinet with six drawers whose top holds photos and keepsakes. A Black Marble Archive (black lacquer, marble top, brass, jute, an LED halo behind the map for the night), B Chalk and Linen (white, moulded paper pulp, natural-and-black cotton, the quietest and cheapest build) and C Honey and Ink (summer-oak mid-century on splayed legs, an anthracite lamp, a terracotta-and-ink rug). Fixed in all three: both arches dark, the honey-amber parquet, Davies Beige blackout and voile with valance boards on the window run, no hallway aircon. Nothing in the hallway is measured: conditional fit; hallway unmeasured.
requirements: Three distinct hallway sets with the same wall composition: the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203 at true scale (1040 x 650, bottom at 1100) over a solid floor-standing cabinet with six or more drawers and a display top. No model or family repeats across the schemes, the parallel Astra hallway set (walnut gallery, pale floating oak, oxblood atelier) or the other rooms' claims.

Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: the ceiling, the corridor width and length, both arches, the window run and the light switch position are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md); every plan and view depends on them until the tape numbers arrive.

The cabinet, lamp, rug and plant are real catalogue products with a supplier photo, price and source link; the map is owner-supplied at nil and the LED halo (scheme A) is an electrical allowance, not a product.

Kept in every scheme: both arches dark, the parquet throughout, Davies Beige blackout + voile with valance boards on the window run (Seoul Blinds offer, priced in the curtain quote, not here), no hallway aircon, no added ceiling light.
procurement_gates: Prices are frozen 20 Oct 2026 catalogue references with each line's own price date. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.

No scheme is purchase-ready until the hallway is taped: the cabinet length against the light switch position and the corridor length, the cabinet depth against the passage width, and the map's hanging height against the cabinet top.
Pieces flagged "dims unpublished" or "partial" in the room placement report (the lamps, the plants, the rug depths) keep the layout size; measure them at the showroom before ordering.
Style renders are AI interpretations painted over the dimension-led model views; the supplier photo boards, the plan and the item schedule are the acceptance basis.

schemes.title: Black Marble Archive
schemes.rationale: a black six-drawer dresser with a white marble top and brass pulls under the map, a gold lamp, natural jute and nothing else on the wall: the map reads as the single lit exhibit, with a slim LED halo behind it for the night (no plant by design; every tall faux tree in the catalogue is already claimed by another room)
fit_notes: Ashley Fargenta 1499 x 406 x 889: top at 889, so the map's bottom edge at 1100 leaves a 211 mm reveal; the map (1040) is centred on the dresser (1499) with 230 mm of top free at each end for the lamp and the photos.

Passage: 2300 (assumed) less 406 leaves about 1.9 m beside the dresser. The map is centred at 2200 from the living end (edges 1680 to 2720); if the light switch proves to sit more than 1.6 m along the wall, slide the whole composition 200 mm toward the dining arch.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).

schemes.title: Chalk and Linen
schemes.rationale: a white six-drawer dresser, a paper-pulp mushroom lamp, a natural-and-black cotton flatweave and a schefflera: the quietest wall for the map and the cheapest full build
fit_notes: IKEA HAUGA 1380 x 460 x 840: top at 840 leaves a 260 mm reveal under the map; the map overhangs nothing (1040 on 1380, 170 mm free each end).
The deepest cabinet of the three: 2300 (assumed) less 460 leaves about 1.84 m of passage; re-check if the corridor tapes under 2.0 m.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).

schemes.title: Honey and Ink
schemes.rationale: a summer-oak mid-century six-drawer on splayed legs, tonal with the parquet, with an anthracite lamp, a terracotta-and-ink geometric rug and a faux monstera: the map's blue is the only cool colour
fit_notes: abensonHome Fowler 1400 x 390 x 780: the lowest top (780) gives a 320 mm reveal under the map; the drawers sit on legs, so the skirting line stays visible along the wall.
Passage: 2300 (assumed) less 390 leaves about 1.9 m; the 80 x 150 rug sits in front of the dresser only, parquet showing on every side.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).
